scope: CLI/MCP/toolbox startup integration; anchored group cleanup; Kimi canonical plan boundary

findings.finding: concurrent MCP cancellation lost cleanup scope after another call cleared child
findings.resolution: only replace cleanup with a non-null confirmed result; real concurrent-abort regression

findings.finding: toolbox could report stopped while supervised cleanup was pending/incomplete
findings.resolution: stopping state, guarded completion update, failed cleanup metadata and stale-child protection

findings.finding: Kimi terminal close treated incomplete cleanup as success
findings.resolution: verify completion even for exited terminals; kill/release report unconfirmed errors

findings.finding: background terminal cleanup rejection could skip main CLI close and owner deletion
findings.resolution: allSettled records failures, nested finally guarantees main close and owner removal, final result preserves incomplete status

followup.finding: failed terminal release removed retry ownership before confirmation
followup.resolution: mark released/delete only after successful cleanup
followup.verification: independent static review and two-attempt release regression

remainingScope: fine-grained tool owners and legacy PID migration
